experiences.selected_diagnosis: strong-resolvent convergence loses the completeness coordinate; it remains usable only when the target family supplies additional spectral-exactness structure

links.rationale: Both failures show that finite-stage self-adjointness plus weak/generic operator approximation does not supply complete spectral exactness.
Both failures leave target identification uncontrolled: one through an unconstrained zero-free factor/growth coordinate, the other through an unconstrained path through cutoff space.
